tools.name: rule_check
tools.description: FREE. Risk-score the settlement rules of a Polymarket market (slug or search words): flags discretion, vague sources, cancellation and deadline traps. Top 2 markets.

tools.name: rule_check_full
tools.description: PRO. Full rule text + resolution source + all flags for up to 10 Polymarket markets matching a slug or search.

tools.name: kalshi_check
tools.description: PRO. Risk-score a Kalshi market's rules by ticker (rules_primary + rules_secondary).

tools.name: scan_risky
tools.description: PRO. Scan the top live Polymarket markets by volume and list the ones with the riskiest settlement wording.

tools.name: market_lookup
tools.description: FREE. Live price, volume and close time for ONE prediction market in the normalised Polymarket+Kalshi schema. Give a Polymarket slug or a Kalshi ticker.

tools.name: live_markets
tools.description: PAID $0.02/call (x402) or subscription. Live open markets from Polymarket and Kalshi in one schema, ranked by 24h volume within each venue (interleaved). Filter by venue or text.

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: PAID $0.02/call (x402) or subscription. Keyword search across live Polymarket and Kalshi markets (e.g. 'fed rate', 'bitcoin', 'election'); normalised prices and volumes.

tools.name: top_movers
tools.description: PAID $0.02/call (x402) or subscription. Live markets with the biggest 24h price moves on Polymarket and Kalshi, in one schema.

tools.name: doubles_record
tools.description: FREE. Sports doubles feed (info only, 18+): the full SETTLED record of Grok Double Bot's daily doubles, every pick including losses, with legs, odds at tip time and result; won/lost/void counts, win rate, average combined odds and running profit on a flat £10 stake. Never shows unsettled picks. Info

tools.name: doubles_today
tools.description: PAID $0.05/call (x402 USDC on Base) or subscription / bundle pass. Sports doubles feed (info only, 18+): today's stats-led doubles from Grok Double Bot with legs, kick-off/start times (UK), odds at tip time, combined odds, confidence and rationale. Information only, not betting advice. No guaranteed

tools.name: kalshi_weather_series
tools.description: FREE. List Kalshi weather series (daily high/low temperature, rain, snow) by city or keyword, with series ticker, frequency and official settlement source. Use the ticker with kalshi_weather_settlements. Information only, not betting advice. Historical settlements do not predict future results. 18+.

tools.name: kalshi_weather_settlements
tools.description: PAID $0.02/call (x402) or subscription / bundle pass. Settled Kalshi weather markets for a series (e.g. KXHIGHNY) or city: per market the ticker, close date, exact close_time (ISO 8601 UTC, Z) and close_time_local (ISO with the city's UTC offset; local_tz IANA zone, null if unknown), settlement_time
